data.title: Rapid Fund Layering Through Shell Accounts
data.description: Detects rapid fund movement through multiple accounts with minimal retention time, indicative of layering through shell or pass-through accounts. Funds transit through each account within hours with near-zero balance retention, suggesting the accounts exist solely to obscure the money trail.

detection.condition: selection_pass_through | near selection_rapid_egress by account_id and selection_low_retention | count() by account_id > 3 within 30d

falsepositives: Escrow or settlement accounts that legitimately have rapid pass-through flows
Operating accounts of payment processors or money service businesses
